findings.summary: previous_defs now holds Line objects, so the truthiness check on self.previous_defs[-1] is always true and no longer means the previous def was indented. For top-level defs or classes followed by a top-level line ending in ':' (such as async with), 'before' becomes 1 instead of 2, which changes default non-preview output. The fix is to use self.previous_defs[-1].depth.
The new test uses preview=True and only covers .pyi input. It has no default-mode test showing that output is unchanged, so it would not catch the regression.
